evals.prompt: Let's use the double-diamond skill with an agent budget of 8 to investigate and implement our new OAuth2 provider integration.
evals.expected_output: Decomposes the OAuth2 integration into Diamond 1 (Research & Specification) and Diamond 2 (Parallel Development & Quality Gating), allocating 4 research subagents, synthesizing a formal specification, and pausing at the User Steering Gate.
assertions: Identifies and activates the double-diamond multi-agent orchestration workflow
Configures Degree of Parallelism (DOP) based on the specified agent budget (e.g., 4 research, 4 dev)
Spawns parallel research subagents across orthogonal vectors (SDK/protocol, codebase integration, token storage/security, error handling)
Enforces the mandatory User Steering Gate before launching any implementation code

evals.prompt: I need to design and build a new caching tier for our database. First run a parallel research phase to explore Redis vs SQLite WAL vs Memcached, write a specification, and then develop it.
evals.expected_output: Executes Diamond 1 research exploration, produces a Technical Specification Document using the template, presents findings and trade-offs to the user at the User Steering Gate, and outlines disjoint work packages for development.
assertions: Splits research into orthogonal vectors (Codebase reconnaissance, Ecosystem/SDK comparison, Performance/Latency, Failure modes)
Synthesizes research into a structured specification with component architecture and system contracts
Partitions implementation into disjoint, non-overlapping work packages
Presents specification and trade-offs to the user for explicit approval before proceeding to Diamond 2

evals.prompt: Given an approved Technical Specification for an event bus with 3 disjoint packages (models, publisher, consumer), execute Diamond 2 implementation and quality verification.
evals.expected_output: Spawns 3 parallel developer subagents with disjoint file allocations, instructs them to run package-scoped tests, and executes delivery quality gates (build, test, lint, spec compliance).
assertions: Assigns mutually exclusive file paths to each developer subagent to prevent merge conflicts
Instructs developer subagents to run targeted package-scoped unit tests rather than broad root sweeps
Executes all four sequential delivery gates: compilation, full test suite, linting, and specification compliance
Produces a verified delivery summary upon completion

evals.prompt: Please fix the typo on line 42 of internal/server/router.go.
evals.expected_output: Directly fixes the typo without invoking double-diamond orchestration or spawning subagents.
assertions: Does not invoke the double-diamond skill or subagent swarms for simple isolated edits

evals.prompt: Run go test ./internal/auth/... and show me the output.
evals.expected_output: Executes the test command directly without triggering double-diamond multi-agent orchestration.
assertions: Does not trigger double-diamond multi-agent orchestration for basic command execution
